Never stand upright or elongate the body.
TIGHT PRODUCT CLOSE-UP, camera framing from BELOW CHIN to desk, eyes and most of face outside frame. Same adult woman, low dark ponytail, cream long-sleeve blouse. The shell lies low in the original diagonal three-quarter pose; black window lower-right and single original loop upper-right. Camera moves closer for a macro view; do not physically enlarge or elongate the product.

No added text anywhere: no captions, subtitles, titles, cards, watermark, readable background signs or invented product lettering. Preserve only intrinsic product markings. No collage or graphic layout.
